chunks: Verily those against whom the word of your Lord is pronounced will never believe,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the 'word of your Lord' has been pronounced upon someone in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is this 'word' (kalamah) often interpreted as the divine decree or seal of God upon those whose hearts have hardened due to persistent rejection, reflecting the interplay between divine foreknowledge and human free will. It underscores that disbelief is not merely a random occurrence but a consequence of their own choices culminating in a fixed state, a concept deeply explored in tafsir works like Al-Mizan.
